caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane rendered with muted colors on a plain, off-white background. At the center of the composition is a vertical black pole, on top of which sits a directional compass rose with the letters “N,” “E,” “S,” and “W” to denote north, east, south, and west, respectively; these letters are in gray with a shaded appearance. Attached to the compass rose is an ornate arrow pointer, colored in brown and outlined with darker shades, pointing toward the left side of the page. Below the compass rose, a spherical object is drawn on the pole, colored brown with greenish-gray highlights to suggest a metallic or polished surface. Near the top right of the paper, there is a small inset rectangle showing a simplified line drawing of the weather vane in proportion. The page has faint pencil guidelines that frame the main drawing and the inset. At the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten note with the artist's name and a date.
title: Weather Vane
